title: Late-Load Credit on the OTC Allowance — Service Credit Clause
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit, over-the-counter allowance.** A late-load credit is added to a member's quarter load where the new load is booked long after the previous one.

**Clause.** The late-load credit looks at the calendar days from the posting date of the previous load to the day the new load is booked: at 120 days or more the credit accrues seventy-five cents ($0.75) for every whole 15 days beyond the first 90 days; from 92 through 119 days it is a flat one dollar fifty ($1.50); below 92 days there is no credit.

The previous load is the latest allowance load already on the member's pharmacy coverage; its posting date is the date of that load entry.

### Method by band

| Calendar days from the previous load's posting date to the booking day | Late-load credit |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | $0.75 for every whole 15 days beyond the first 90 days; a part of 15 days earns nothing |
| 92 through 119 | A flat $1.50 |
| Below 92 | Nothing |

### Worked days (hypothetical)

| Days | Days beyond the first 90 | Whole 15-day periods | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 91 | — | — | Nothing |
| 92 | — | — | $1.50 |
| 119 | — | — | $1.50 |
| 120 | 30 | 2 | $1.50 |
| 134 | 44 | 2 | $1.50 |
| 135 | 45 | 3 | $2.25 |
| 181 | 91 | 6 | $4.50 |
